Application Data.NAME: Acme Ambulance Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Ambulance Services provides emergency medical transportation and non-emergency patient transport services, maintaining a fleet of fully equipped ambulances. Our trained personnel deliver basic life support and advanced life support services, ensuring compliance with all local and national regulations. We conduct regular staff training and drills to uphold high standards of care. Additionally, we provide community education programs on CPR and first aid. All operations are supported by a state-of-the-art alarm system, and we adhere to NFPA standards to minimize risks. Equipment maintenance is performed by certified technicians, and we disclose any ancillary services, such as equipment rental, during the underwriting process.
